title: LLMs as information warriors? Auditing how LLM-powered chatbots tackle disinformation about Russia’s war in Ukraine
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing the accuracy and presence of disinformation narratives in LLM outputs. While it investigates topics with ethical weight (such as war crimes and genocide), the evaluation criteria are based on factual baselines and the detection of propaganda/misinformation rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, theological frameworks, or formal systems of morals and ethics.
